claims: The Artemis II mission launch is on April 1, 2026.
The Artemis II launch is scheduled for roughly 6:35 p.m. EDT.
The Artemis II mission is a 10-day mission around the moon and back.
NASA’s AROW is the Artemis Real-time Orbit Website.
NASA’s AROW provides live tracking of the Orion capsule's journey.
